برای بررسی زنده دسترسی «اجرا»ی مانیتورین: Live check needs “Run” access to Monitoring.
برای عیب‌یابی: CPU و ترافیک همه‌ی پورت‌ه: For troubleshooting: CPU and the traffic of all ports are read at a short interval. Nothing is stored, and normal checks, alerts and the device charts are not affected. It stops when this window closes or after 15 minutes. Frequent polling adds some load on the device CPU.
برای پورت‌ها در این بازه تاریخچه‌ای نیست: No port history in this range (port history is off in the monitoring policy or target settings, or there is no data yet).
Live check is only for SNMP targets.
بررسی زنده‌ی موقت هر {0} ثانیه شروع شد: Temporary live check every {0} seconds started
به‌روزرسانی خودکار فقط برای بازه‌ای است: Auto refresh only works for a range that ends “now”; choose “Last 1 hour” or similar.
حجم تقریبی هر دستگاه (سوییچ ۴۸ پورت با ت: Approximate size per device (48-port switch with traffic): 5 minutes ≈ 0.7 MB and 1 minute ≈ 3.5 MB per day. Detailed data keeps its resolution until the end of retention and is never merged; with retention 0 (unlimited) and 1-minute resolution, each device takes about 1.3 GB per year. Long-range charts show a summary; zoom into any day to see the detailed data.
خواندن هر چند ثانیه برای عیب‌یابی؛ ذخیره: Poll every few seconds for troubleshooting; not stored
در انتظار دو بار خواندن برای محاسبه‌ی تر: Waiting for two polls to calculate traffic…
رنگ = درصد ظرفیت پورت (اگر سرعت معلوم اس: Color = % of port capacity (when the speed is known), otherwise relative to the busiest port. Hover the cells to see values.
فقط IPهای یک کشور (کد کشور دقیق، نه جستج: Only IPs of one country (exact country code, not a text search)
فقط IPهایی که دست‌کم این تعداد روزِ مختل: Only IPs checked in AbuseIPDB on at least this many different days

همه‌ی ابزارها جز مانیتورینگ خاموش؛ منو ف: Turn off every tool except Monitoring; the menu shows only monitoring sections
